data.name: Akhlaas
data.gender_notes: Akhlaas is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-l-s', meaning 'hidden, secret, private'. In Islamic context, Akhlaas refers to righteousness, modesty, and wisdom. It signifies being humble, discreet, and avoiding the limelight. The name Akhlaas carries the meaning “Privately, secretly, modest” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akhlaas usually hope their child will grow to embody privately, secretly, modest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to uphold modesty and righteousness, even in private.
data.etymology: Akhlaas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Privately, secretly, modest.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akhlaas total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أخلاص
in_arabic.meaning: إخلاص النية لله تعالى في العبادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'أخلاص' مشتق من الجذر 'خلص' الذي يعني التحرير من الشرك أو الخلط. في القرآن الكريم، الإخلاص هو صفة من صفات الله تعالى، كما في سورة الإخلاص. الاسم يدل على نقاء النية وصفاء القلب في العبادة والتوحيد.

in_urdu.name: اخلاص
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالی کی رضا اور عبادت میں مخلصی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام 'اخلاص' عربی جڑ 'خلص' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے شرک یا آلودگی سے آزادی۔ اسلامی روایت میں، اخلاص عبادت اور توحید میں مخلصی کی علامت ہے، جیسے کہ سورة اخلاص میں بیان کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام عبادت میں نیت کی پاکیزگی اور دل کی صفائی پر دلالت کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अख्लास
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की पूजा में सच्चाई और समर्पण
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम 'अख्लास' अरबी जड़ 'خلص' (ख़लस) से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है भक्ति या पूजा में सच्चाई। इस्लामी परंपरा में, अख्लास सच्ची भक्ति और एकेश्वरवाद का प्रतीक है, जैसा कि सूरा अख्लास में बताया गया है। यह नाम पूजा में सच्चाई और हृदय की पवित्रता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: اخلاص
in_pashto.meaning: په عبادت کې د الله پاک سره خلوص
in_pashto.long_meaning: د 'اخلاص' نوم د عربي ريښې 'خلص' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د شرک څخه د خلاصون معنی لري. په اسلامي دود کې، اخلاص د عبادت او توحيد په معنا دی، لکه څنګه چې د سورت اخلاص په قرآن کريم کې بيان شوی دی. دا نوم په عبادت کې د نيت پاکۍ او د زړه صفايۍ ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Akhlaas
in_english.long_meaning: The name Akhlaas is derived from the Arabic root 'خلص' (khalasa), meaning to free from partnership or mixture. In Islamic tradition, Akhlaas signifies sincerity in worship and devotion to Allah, as mentioned in Surah Al-Ikhlas. The name connotes purity of intention and heart in religious practice.

data.cultural_impact: In various Islamic communities, the name Akhlaas is highly esteemed due to its association with the virtues of righteousness, modesty, and wisdom. It encourages the bearer to lead a righteous life, maintain a good character, and be mindful of their actions in public and private Life. This name is often admired for its embodiment of the ideal Muslim, one who values moral virtues over worldly possessions.
data.spiritual_significance: Akhlaas holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims as it symbolizes an inner purification and striving for God's pleasure. It reminds us to be humble, seek knowledge, and strive for a closer relationship with Allah. The name promotes hiding one's good deeds and motivations from the worldly gaze, focusing on pleasing Allah instead. In Islamic spirituality, Akhlaas is a reminder to cultivate a hidden goodness, cultivating healing in both oneself and others.
